description: gen schema --check ignores the generator version wherever generation writes it, and nothing else: two generations are byte-identical, provenance included, and the unchanged tree is current; a tree whose manifest records another generator version is still current with no finding; and a tree whose Cargo.toml [package] version equals the version that manifest records, not the running generator's, is current too, so a generator upgrade alone never fails the check

command: "$KDLITH_FX_KDLITH" gen schema inputs/schema.kdl --crate parts-proc --out out --kdlith-workspace --check; echo "exit=$?"
stdout-contains:
ok: schema crate parts-proc at out is current (11 owned files)
exit=0

command: sed -i 's/^#@ generator kdlith version="[^"]*"$/#@ generator kdlith version="0.0.9"/' out/kdlith-manifest && grep -c '^#@ generator kdlith version="0.0.9"$' out/kdlith-manifest && "$KDLITH_FX_KDLITH" gen schema inputs/schema.kdl --crate parts-proc --out out --kdlith-workspace --check 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"
stdout-contains:
1
ok: schema crate parts-proc at out is current (11 owned files)
exit=0

command: sed -i '0,/^version = "[^"]*"$/s//version = "0.0.9"/' out/Cargo.toml && grep -c '^version = "0.0.9"$' out/Cargo.toml && "$KDLITH_FX_KDLITH" gen schema inputs/schema.kdl --crate parts-proc --out out --kdlith-workspace --check 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"
stdout-contains:
1
ok: schema crate parts-proc at out is current (11 owned files)
exit=0
